import re
import urllib.request
import urllib.error

url = 'http://localhost:3123/'
html = urllib.request.urlopen(url).read().decode()
forms = re.findall(r'<form.*?</form>', html)
form = next(form for form in forms if 'name=\"message\"' in form)
action = re.search(r'name=\"(\\"'$ACTION_ID_[''^"]+)"'"', form).group(1)

def submit(fields):
    boundary = 'ContactFormTestBoundary'
    data = b''.join(
        (f'--{boundary}\\r\\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"{name}\"\\r\\n\\r\\n{value}\\r\\n').encode()
        for name, value in [(action, ''), *fields.items()]
    ) + f'--{boundary}--\\r\\n'.encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, headers={'Content-Type': f'multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}'})
    try:
        return urllib.request.urlopen(req).status
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        return error.code

valid = submit({'name': '  Test Name  ', 'email': 'test@example.com', 'message': '  Hello  '})
invalid = submit({'name': '  ', 'email': 'test@example.com', 'message': 'Hello'})
print(f'Valid submission: HTTP {valid}; whitespace-only name: HTTP {invalid}')
assert valid == 200 and invalid == 500
PY"

import re
import urllib.request
import urllib.error

url = 'http://localhost:3123/'
html = urllib.request.urlopen(url).read().decode()
forms = re.findall(r'<form.*?</form>', html)
form = next(form for form in forms if 'name=\"message\"' in form)
action = re.search(r'name=\"(\\"'$ACTION_ID_[''^"]+)"'"', form).group(1)

def submit(fields):
    boundary = 'ContactFormTestBoundary'
    data = b''.join(
        (f'--{boundary}\\r\\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"{name}\"\\r\\n\\r\\n{value}\\r\\n').encode()
        for name, value in [(action, ''), *fields.items()]
    ) + f'--{boundary}--\\r\\n'.encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, headers={'Content-Type': f'multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}'})
    try:
        return urllib.request.urlopen(req).status
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        return error.code

valid = submit({'name': '  Test Name  ', 'email': 'test@example.com', 'message': '  Hello  '})
invalid = submit({'name': '  ', 'email': 'test@example.com', 'message': 'Hello'})
print(f'Valid submission: HTTP {valid}; whitespace-only name: HTTP {invalid}')
assert valid == 200 and invalid == 500
PY"
